title: Personal Checking: Charges for Wires, Official Checks, Stop Payments, Card Replacement and Research
content:
## Basis

Personal Checking service charges are booked as fee entries at the tier the account holds on the day the service is given. Where a tier's price for a service is 0.00, no fee entry is booked. Service charges sit outside the daily ceiling on overdraft item fees.

## What each service costs and how it is booked

| Service | Charge | Linked entry |
|---|---|---|
| Wire sent within the United States | the tier's outgoing domestic wire fee | names the wire debit |
| Wire sent abroad | the tier's outgoing international wire fee | names the wire debit |
| Wire received | the tier's incoming wire fee | — |
| Official (cashier's) check bought | the tier's official check fee | — |
| Stop payment order, or renewal of one | the tier's stop payment fee, apart from the free allowance below | names the order |
| Replacement debit card, card lost or damaged | the tier's standard replacement fee | — |
| Replacement debit card, card stolen, compromised or expired | no standard replacement fee | — |
| Rush delivery of a replacement card, any reason | the tier's rush delivery fee, on top of any standard fee | — |
| Research on the account requested by the customer | the tier's hourly research fee for every hour begun, at least one hour | — |

## Free stop orders

In each statement cycle, the tier's allowance of free stop payment orders and renewals is used up in the order the orders were placed; later orders in that cycle are charged.

## Research that is never charged

Research needed to look into a bank error or a dispute is not billed, whatever the tier.

## Hypothetical cases

- Research requested by the customer takes 1 hour 10 minutes: two hours have been begun, so the charge is twice the tier's hourly figure. Research lasting 20 minutes is still charged as one full hour.
- A card reported stolen and sent by rush delivery draws only the rush delivery fee.
- On a tier whose allowance is one free stop order per cycle, a second stop order and a renewal later in the same cycle are both charged.
